描述_ZN: Songluo Visiting Stele Book, Qing dynasty, painted by Huang Yi, on paper with ink brush, each opening 17.5 cm long and 50.8 cm wide.　　Inscribed with a poem inscribed in seal script by Sun Xingyan, "Songluo Visits the Monuments in 24 Pictures". The folio is inscribed by Weng Fanggang, and five others, including Wang Niansun, Hong Fan, He Qi, Yi Bingshou, and Dong Shixi. The back paper has eight inscriptions by Liang Tongshu, Xi Gang, Song Baocun, Xu Shangzhi, Wang Bingtao, Chen Gong, He Shaoji (two), and Qi Junzao.　　This panel and the back paper bear the marks of Li Zoxian and Pang Laishen.　　Song Luo Visiting Tablet" is a field record of Huang Yi's search for inscriptions and the places he visited. There are twenty-four locations: Waiting for the Ci Temple, Xuanyuan, Dajue Temple, Songyang Academy, Zhongyue Temple, Shaomu Shiqu, Kaiyuan Temple, Taihang Autumn Color, Shaolin Temple, Shigong, Kaimu Shiqu, Huishan Temple, Baima Temple, Songyue Temple, Yiqu, Longmen Mountain, Xiang Mountain, Fengxian Temple, Mang Mountain, Laojun Cave, Equality Temple, Gou Mountain, Jin Tablet, and Xiaoshishan House. The artist inscribed each opening with its own name, and the opposite opening is self-titled and annotated. The composition is simple and light, with a cool and elegant look, and a sense of antiquity in the lightness of the painting.
